01 / The challenge

The challenge for cleaning companies.

Cleaning firms often run a mix of small cars and vans driven by different team members. Matching graphics make the whole team look professional and help customers recognise who is at the door.

01

Mixed small cars and vans

Hatchbacks and vans need to look like the same company.

02

Trust at the door

Customers want to know the person arriving is from your company.

03

Domestic and commercial

Different customers need different messages.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Company name
  • Domestic, commercial or end-of-tenancy
  • Phone number and website
  • Insurance or DBS-checked messaging, if relevant

Not sure what to include? Our guide to what to put on a work van walks you through it.

PackagePrice guideTypical scope

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Design for the smallest car first

If it works on a small hatchback, it will work on a van.

02

Use fresh colours

Clean, light colours suit the sector and stand out on residential streets.

03

Mention trust signals

DBS checks and insurance reassure domestic customers.

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you brand small hatchbacks?

Yes. We will adapt your design to fit the smaller panels and windows.

Can the graphics be removed later?

Yes. Quality vinyl can be removed cleanly, which is useful for leased cars.

Can you do a few cars at a time?

Yes. We can schedule fitting so the team keeps working.
